capabilities: Render themed magic item cards from itemcard YAML code blocks
Save and manage items in a global catalog
Preview cards inline via wc:Item Name syntax or internal links
Insert a blank magic item template via a command
Customize card fields such as image, rarity, attunement and price
disambiguation: Not a flashcard or spaced-repetition tool; it renders visual cards for D&D magic items.
extras: The manifest description and card field examples are largely in Russian (e.g. rarity values like "легендарный", prices like "500 зм").
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render game-ready magic item cards with images, rarity, price and attunement inside notes.
summary: D&D magic item card renderer that turns itemcard YAML code blocks into themed cards with a global catalog and inline previews.
